# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Ocarina of Time real-time speed (the "Real-time speed (built-in)" add-on): below 60 fps the game
# gets the measured frame time as its step, so it no longer runs in slow motion. =0 leaves the
# patch out: the game's own fixed step (slow motion below 60 fps). "Dynamic FPS by Dark (built-in)"
# hooks the same code and applies only when Real-time speed is disabled in Add-Ons.
#EDEN_NX2_OOT_REAL_TIME=0
# Deltas below this (default 1.03 = 58.3 fps) are delivered as the fixed 1.0. Range 1.0-1.5. =1.1
# (the earlier default, 54.5 fps) ignores more jitter near 60 fps but runs 54.5-58 fps up to 10 %
# slow, with a speed step where the smoothed frame time crosses 18.3 ms.
#EDEN_NX2_OOT_REAL_TIME_SNAP=1.1

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# Macro DMA reads of occlusion reports wait for the reports' host results (#204/#215). Default:
# only reads of a range holding a tracked report wait; =all every read (each drains the split);
# =0 none (A/B test of the wait; reads can return older counts).
#EDEN_NX2_QUERY_REPORT_WAIT=0

# Texture joins (#288): when one alias copy writes a whole new image, its upload from guest memory
# and the older alias copies are skipped (Ocarina's resized shadow map). =0 makes them all again.
#EDEN_NX2_JOIN_UPLOAD_SKIP=0

# Diagnostic (#210): build these compute shaders unoptimized on any driver (comma-separated
# hexadecimal hashes, or all). Shorter driver compiles, slower shaders.
#EDEN_NX2_NOOPT_SHADERS=74ab167d83c54073,f12162b84e9cc190

# Storage buffer pointer rules: unset = upstream #150 only (default since test/oot-local-7 and
# test/oot-local-11). =local adds our dynamic constant buffer and record pointer paths on top (the
# oot-local-6 default; it lost Kokiri Forest's tree canopy there). =upstream is the same as unset.
#EDEN_NX2_POINTER_RULES=local

# Fast draws (EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW=2), handle checks of the existing paths, on by default: a delta
# draw after writes with no known range, and a reused draw of a pipeline whose texture handles come
# from storage buffers, read the handles again and are resolved in full if one changed. =0 skips.
#EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW_CHECK_INVALIDATED=0
#EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW_CHECK_REUSED=0

# Feedback loop barriers: the cached answer also needs the same sampled views (default). =0 keys it
# by the render target and texture table serials only, as before.
#EDEN_NX2_FEEDBACK_VIEWS=0

# Fast draws (EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW=2), more delta draws, off by default (=1 turns each on):
# pipelines with texture handles computed from storage buffers (handles read again each draw);
# handle constant buffer writes (handles read again, changed ones resolved again); vertex stream
# stride/enable and attribute format changes on dynamic vertex input pipelines.
#EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW_COMPUTED=1
#EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW_HANDLE_DATA=1
#EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW_VERTEX_INPUT=1
